title: Teamwork
description: NCERT Class 5 English (Marigold): 'Teamwork'. New words, comprehension, pronouns (he, she, it, they, we), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Teamwork': team, together, win, support.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Teamwork' mean (team, together, win, support); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A group that plays or works together is a ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: To help and encourage someone is to ___ them.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: The players passed the ball, and they scored together.
She is the captain, and we follow her.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Teamwork' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Teamwork'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The poem says a team can win only when members work ___.
The poem says a team wins only when its members work ___.

exemplars: The players passed the ball, and they scored together.
She is the captain, and we follow her.

nodes.title: Pronouns (he, she, it, they, we)
nodes.skill: Use pronouns (he, she, it, they, we) correctly.
nodes.teach_focus: A pronoun takes the place of a naming word: Ravi -> he; the girls -> they; the ball -> it.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses pronouns (he, she, it, they, we) correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of pronouns (he, she, it, they, we).

bridge_exercises.sentence: Replace the names: 'Ravi and Sita played. ___ played well.'
Meera is my friend. ___ is very kind. (she/he)
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: Ravi and Sita played, and they won.
Meera is kind; she helps everyone.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Teamwork'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Teamwork': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: My team wins because we ___ each other.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Meera is my friend. ___ is very kind. (she/he)
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: The players passed the ball, and they scored together.
She is the captain, and we follow her.
